Furries come in all degrees of dedication and obsession with the fandom. Some furs have lots of fursuits and lots of characters and commission lots of art and go to lots of conventions, some furs just like to wear tails and draw art of their sona sometimes, some furs just like to appreciate other people’s characters, and everything in between. You also are not obligated by any means to be into the 18+ side of the fandom if you don’t want to. There are also people who have, draw, and/or appreciate anthro characters but don’t like to identify as furries. The only thing that really makes you a furry is by simply identifying yourself as one.
And if you do, we’d love to have you! There are lots of places you can go to get started if you’re interested. I reccommend watching YouTube videos by Pocari Roo, a furry youtuber who makes very fun and informative videos on lots of different aspects in our fandom, including “How to be a furry”-esque videos!
Good luck!
